root_cause: The test asserts that a Convert node's selected implementation ('primType') matches the expected 'ref_i8' primitive, but the executed graph reports 'unknown_I8' instead. This is the same class of intermittent primType mismatch previously seen for other CPU layer tests (MvnLayerCPUTest, PoolingLayerCPUTest, ConvertCPULayerTest 7D) on this Linux ARM64 ACL-enabled runner, where the exec-graph RTInfo IMPL_TYPE attribute is not reliably populated/propagated for certain dynamic-shape or ACL-backed executors, producing a placeholder 'unknown_*' value instead of the real backend name. The triggering commit (#39540) only changes CI workflow scheduling for C++20 build checks and does not touch CPU plugin code, Convert implementation selection, or test utilities, so it is not the root cause; this is an independent, pre-existing flaky test surfacing in the same post-commit run.
reproduction_steps: Build the Linux ARM64 CPU plugin and run: ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_ConvertCPULayerTest_4D_Dynamic*ref*i8* repeatedly (several iterations); the failure is intermittent and may require multiple runs or the exact ARM64/ACL environment to reproduce.
recommended_actions: Investigate why getExecValue(ov::exec_model_info::IMPL_TYPE) can return 'unknown_I8' instead of the real primitive name for Convert nodes with dynamic shapes on the ACL-enabled ARM64 CPU plugin build.
Check whether the RTInfo IMPL_TYPE attribute is being set before the test reads it, or if there's a race/ordering issue in exec-graph annotation for ACL executors.

Consider adding a retry/rerun marker or quarantining smoke_ConvertCPULayerTest_4D_Dynamic (and related ConvertCPULayerTest/MvnLayerCPUTest/PoolingLayerCPUTest ACL variants) if the root cause cannot be fixed quickly, given the recurring 'unknown_*' vs expected primType pattern across different test suites.
Link this investigation group to existing pattern hashes 56c268ac84902dce, 809d4bb416b7d3e9, d94563b07437b23b, 2640902748a867ec for cross-test correlation.
prevention_strategies: Add CI-side flaky-test detection/quarantine for primType-check assertions on ACL-backed executors, and add diagnostic logging (already behind #ifndef NDEBUG) to capture IMPL_TYPE population timing in CI debug builds so transient 'unknown_*' states can be root-caused.
historical_context: This is the fifth recorded occurrence of the 'primType is unexpected: unknown_*/undef_* vs expected' failure class on Linux ARM64 ACL builds, following MvnLayerCPUTest (2026-11-02), PoolingLayerCPUTest AvgPool (2026-09-30), PoolingLayerCPUTest MaxPool (2026-10-15), and ConvertCPULayerTest 7D Dynamic ref primType (2026-10-07). All prior occurrences were isolated single events (count=1) with no fix landed yet; this new signature (ConvertCPULayerTest 4D Dynamic ref primType i8) is a distinct but related pattern.
